subject: MAP: CedarBank evaluation & acceptance — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA, data retention
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@cedarbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: CedarBank Security Team <security@cedarbank.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: MAP + acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team appreciated the throughput numbers. We need to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) so our procurement and security teams can sign off. High-level asks from Security & Legal:

- SOC 2 Type II evidence (control mapping to our ingestion/retention flow)
- SIG/CAIQ export or completed questionnaire
- Draft DPA redline + confirmation on deletion timelines and backup retention
- Explicit data retention windows for logs, KV cache, and production customer data (requirements: support 30/90/365 day options; some data must be kept 7 years for audits)

Can you put together a 2–3 week evaluation timeline with owners for each artifact? Also please confirm if you can provide a limited canary test with EU residency for a sample tenant.

We're aiming for a contract signature by end of April, so tight runway.

Asha
Asha Patel
CTO, CedarBank
asha.patel@cedarbank.com

Subject: Re: Request: MAP + acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Asha — thanks, and glad the demo was useful. I've sketched a short MAP and attached a working spreadsheet (CedarBank_MAP_v3.xlsx) that breaks down deliverables, owners, and target dates. Summary below.

High level proposal (two-week focused eval track + contractual close):
- Week 1 (Mar 12–18): Evidence intake and technical run — SOC2 summary, CAIQ export, DPA redline, sample EU tenant provisioning (canary). Owner: Hannah / Soojin.
- Week 2 (Mar 19–25): Integration run + security walkthroughs (control mapping, network diagrams). Owner: Soojin.
- Mar 26–Apr 2: Legal negotiation on DPA redlines; finalize retention windows. Owner: Kimberly (legal).
- Target: Contract signature by Apr 30, with Dedicated capacity cutover in June if needed.

Security specifics we propose to include in MAP (please confirm):
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II report for 2027 (summary attached). For control mapping, we'll deliver a matrix mapping CedarBank ingestion and storage flows to our SOC controls within 3 business days of kickoff.
- SIG/CAIQ: full export (CAIQ JSON) attached; we'll highlight controls relevant to data residency, encryption, and key management.
- DPA: standard Redwood DPA with one requested carve (EU residency option + 30-day deletion upon customer request). We'll attach a redline for your legal.
- Retention: propose configurable tiers — Ephemeral session/KV cache: 30 days default; Request logs & tracing: 90 days default; Customer data (production blobs): configurable 30/90/365; Backups: encrypted, 90 days default, 7-year archival on request with separate arrangement.

Immediate next steps:
1) I'll upload the MAP v3 to the shared Drive and drop the link.
2) Soojin will provision a canary EU tenant by EOD Monday (Mar 12) and share access.
3) Kimberly will send a DPA redline to Asha by Mar 13.

If that timeline looks good, we'll lock owners and dates in the spreadsheet and push to your procurement hub.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: MAP + acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Asha — quick technical notes to clarify scope for the MAP.

1) EU canary: we can provision a scoped tenant in eu-west-1 with isolated VPC and customer-managed keys (KMS) within 24–48 hours. That tenant will be configured to enforce data residency for model inputs and embeddings.

2) SOC2 control mapping: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf attached. We'll map the following controls specifically for your intake pipeline: access management (IAM), key management (KMS/HSM), encryption in transit & at rest (TLS 1.3 / AES-256), logging and monitoring (retention and SIEM exports), and incident response. Expect a control-by-control mapping document within two business days after kickoff.

3) Data retention detail: Redis/KV cache TTLs are configurable; we recommend a 30-day default but can set a 24-hour TTL for high-sensitivity tenants. For backups: snapshots are encrypted, retained 90 days by default; we can scope 7-year archival under a separate contractual addendum.

4) DPA redline: Kimberly's going to circulate a draft, but from infra side we prefer the following default language: 30 days to delete customer data from active stores; 90 days to purge logs and backups; certification that export/erasure is completed (audit trail). If CedarBank requires shorter windows (e.g., immediate deletion <30d), we need to scope the impact on caching and model-serving performance.

I'll post test creds for the EU tenant once provisioning completes and attach the CAIQ export for your reviewers.

- Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Thanks Hannah / Soojin — helpful and clear. A few quick responses from our side:

- Canary: yes, please provision eu-west-1 scoped tenant and provide a short checklist we can use for smoke tests (latency, data egress checks, sample inference).
- SOC2: the summary is fine; we will need the control mapping to our PII/processes before our auditors sign off (expected by Mar 18).
- DPA: our legal proposes two small changes to your suggested language: (1) a 14-day deletion window for session data, (2) explicit certification for deletion of backups that may sit outside primary region. We'll attach our counter redline once legal has it (target 3/15).

If you can accept the 14-day session deletion and provide a short note on operational impact, we can keep the MAP timeline tight. Also can you generate one-page artifacts we can include in our procurement packet (SOC2 snapshot + CAIQ summary + DPA redline)?

Asha

Asha — appreciate the quick turn. Confirming next steps and owners (locking dates into MAP_v3):

- Mar 15: Kimberly to send redline_DPA_CedarBank.docx (legal-to-legal). Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Mar 16: Soojin to share EU canary access + smoke test checklist. Owner: Soojin Lee.
- Mar 18: Redwood to deliver SOC2 control mapping & one-page SOC2 snapshot for procurement. Owner: Hannah / Soojin.
- Mar 20: Joint security walkthrough (30–45 minutes) to validate mapping and sign-off criteria.
- Mar 25: Finalize retention windows & DPA; lock contract redlines.

Operational note on the 14-day deletion ask: we can support a 14-day TTL for session/KV cache with negligible performance impact if configured for the tenant at provisioning. Backup/archival deletion beyond primary stores requires a separate attestation workflow (we will surface audit-proof deletion events but long-term archival removal may take up to 90 days depending on provider snapshot replication). We will call this out in the DPA redline and in the control mapping.

I'll upload the updated MAP and include the legal redline when Kimberly sends it. If this looks good, I'll schedule the walkthrough for Mar 20 and send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Hannah
